answer.says: You are right, Mrs. Kapoor. I was in a hurry to reach the Directorate before it closed, but I see now that my haste was a form of evasion. Please, tell me again what you mean by the 'mess' speaking for itself. I am listening.
answer.thought: She has caught the movement of my thought before it could complete itself. I am sitting, physically and intellectually. I must not let the fear of the closing time dictate the shape of this conversation; the content must determine the time, not the other way around.
